Extend an mdim VRT recipe to a full file set

Source: R/vrtstack-mdim.R
mdim_template_extend.Rd

Pure XML-tree rewrite (no GDAL needed). Sets the concat dimension size, rewrites the concat coordinate array's values, and regenerates the <Source> list of every data array (an <Array> that owns a <Source>). Per-array SourceArray path and slab geometry are read from the array's first source, never assumed from the array name.

Usage

mdim_template_extend(xml, files, concat_values = NULL, concat_dim = "time")

Arguments

xml

Template VRT as an XML string (or anything xml2::read_xml() takes).

files

Full character vector of sources.

concat_values

Values for the concat coordinate array, or NULL to keep the template's values (only valid when length matches files).

concat_dim

Concat dimension name (default "time"); if not found, the dimension whose size equals the template's per-array source count is used.

Value

An xml_document (serialise with as.character() / xml2::write_xml()).
